## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Topology
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Mesh edge lists and adjacency tables
//  - Topological classification
//  - Half-edge and corner connectivity
//  - Typed mesh element indices

//==
// # Mesh edge lists and adjacency tables
//
// The derived connectivity tables of a mesh: undirected edges named by their
// endpoint vertices, and the vertex/face neighbourhood tables built over them.
//
// The adjacency tables are IJagged (CSR) row collections — packing invariant on
// the `IJagged` interface in `collections.concepts.plato`; the payload
// projections are in `topology.library.plato`.

//==
// ## Undirected edges as vertex pairs

// An undirected edge named by its two endpoint vertices. The canonical form
// orders the pair so that A.Value <= B.Value; producers emit canonical pairs
// unless documented otherwise (LineSet segments preserve authored direction).
type VertexPair
    implements IValue, IHashable
{
    A: VertexIndex;
    B: VertexIndex;
}

// The undirected edges of a mesh, extracted once and stored canonically:
// each pair ordered A.Value <= B.Value, pairs sorted lexicographically.
// An edge's position in this array is its UndirectedEdgeIndex.
type UndirectedEdgeList
    implements IValue
{
    UndirectedEdges: Array<VertexPair>;
}

// Per-edge incident faces, parallel to an UndirectedEdgeList: LeftFaces[i] is
// the face on the side of UndirectedEdges[i] where the traversal A to B runs
// counter-clockwise along the face loop; RightFaces[i] is the opposite side. A
// boundary edge stores -1 in RightFaces; a wire edge stores -1 in both.
type UndirectedEdgeAdjacency
    implements IValue
{
    UndirectedEdges: Array<VertexPair>;
    LeftFaces: Array<FaceIndex>;
    RightFaces: Array<FaceIndex>;
}

//==
// ## Adjacency tables (CSR)

// Vertex-to-vertex adjacency: one row per vertex, so Offsets has
// (vertex count + 1) entries. Each vertex's neighbour run is sorted ascending.
type VertexAdjacency
    implements IValue, IJagged<VertexIndex>
{
    Offsets: Array<Integer>;
    Neighbors: Array<VertexIndex>;
}

// IFace-to-face adjacency across shared edges: one row per face, so Offsets has
// (face count + 1) entries. Row f holds the faces sharing an edge with face f.
type FaceAdjacency
    implements IValue, IJagged<FaceIndex>
{
    Offsets: Array<Integer>;
    Neighbors: Array<FaceIndex>;
}

// The faces incident to each vertex: one row per vertex, so Offsets has
// (vertex count + 1) entries. Row v holds the faces touching vertex v.
type VertexFaceAdjacency
    implements IValue, IJagged<FaceIndex>
{
    Offsets: Array<Integer>;
    Faces: Array<FaceIndex>;
}

//==
// # Topological classification
//
// How a surface is oriented and how close it is to being a 2-manifold, plus the
// aggregate element counts and Euler characteristic that summarize a mesh's
// topology.

// The rotational direction of a face loop as seen from the front side.
// CounterClockwise is the library default
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Curve_orientation).
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding, handedness, and normals (right-handed,
// CCW-front; mirroring inverts winding).
type WindingOrder = CounterClockwise | Clockwise;

// How close a surface is to being a 2-manifold
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IManifold): IManifold means every undirected
// edge borders exactly two faces and vertex stars are disks;
// ManifoldWithBoundary allows undirected edges bordering one or two faces.
type Manifoldness = Unknown | Manifold | ManifoldWithBoundary | NonManifold;

// Aggregate topological measurements of a mesh. EulerCharacteristic equals
// VertexCount - UndirectedEdgeCount + FaceCount
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euler_characteristic); a closed connected
// manifold of genus g has Euler characteristic 2 - 2g. The edge count is of
// DEDUPLICATED undirected edges — half the half-edge count on a closed
// manifold — or the characteristic is wrong.
type TopologySummary
    implements IValue
{
    VertexCount: Integer;
    UndirectedEdgeCount: Integer;
    FaceCount: Integer;
    BoundaryLoopCount: Integer;
    ConnectedComponentCount: Integer;
    EulerCharacteristic: Integer;
    Manifoldness: Manifoldness;
}

//==
// # Half-edge and corner connectivity
//
// The two explicit connectivity encodings that support constant-time
// neighbourhood navigation: the half-edge structure for general polygon meshes,
// and the corner table for triangle meshes. Both name their neighbours by typed
// index, with -1 standing for a boundary or a hole.

//==
// ## Half-edge structures

// One directed side of an undirected mesh edge
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doubly_connected_edge_list). Origin is the
// vertex this half-edge leaves. Next and Previous walk the loop of the
// bordered face in counter-clockwise order. Twin is the oppositely directed
// half-edge, -1 when the edge is on a boundary. IFace is the bordered face, -1
// when this half-edge runs along a hole.
type HalfEdge
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: VertexIndex;
    Twin: HalfEdgeIndex;
    Next: HalfEdgeIndex;
    Previous: HalfEdgeIndex;
    Face: FaceIndex;
}

// A 3D mesh in half-edge form, supporting constant-time neighborhood
// navigation. FaceHalfEdges[f] is one half-edge on face f's loop;
// VertexHalfEdges[v] is one half-edge leaving vertex v, -1 for an isolated
// vertex. Requires a manifold (possibly bounded) surface.
type HalfEdgeMesh
    implements IValue, IMeshElementCounts, IHalfEdge, IDeformable3D
{
    Positions: Array<Point3D>;
    HalfEdges: Array<HalfEdge>;
    FaceHalfEdges: Array<HalfEdgeIndex>;
    VertexHalfEdges: Array<HalfEdgeIndex>;
}
```
